about: The task graph for the autonomous run. Protected. A task is done when its referee checks pass, never because someone says so. File layouts are in referee/CONTRACT.md. {T} is the task folder, experiments/<task>.

per_task.title: Build the environment and record it
per_task.detail: Install per SPEC.md Setup. Write {T}/stage0/env.json with versions, renderer, timings and the stock evaluator command template.

per_task.title: Convert the checkpoint
per_task.detail: Run LeRobot's migration script into checkpoints/<task>. Write {T}/stage0/checkpoint.json with its SHA-256.

per_task.title: Write the five harness tests
per_task.detail: tests/ must define test_fast_harness_matches_stock, test_head_scaling_exact, test_sham_edit_identical, test_repeat_run_identical and test_seed_lock, and they must pass.

per_task.title: Reproduce the published evaluation
per_task.detail: Run lerobot-eval on seeds 1000 to 1499 into {T}/stage0/stock_eval/. Success must land in the reproduction window.

per_task.title: Compare with the published per-seed file
per_task.detail: Download the hub's eval_info.json to {T}/stage0/published_eval_info.json and redraw the failure map from it.

per_task.title: Build the fast harness and match the stock run
per_task.detail: awe/ implements the contract in referee/CONTRACT.md. Run seeds 1000 to 1499 into {T}/stage0/harness_repro.jsonl. At least 98% must agree with lerobot-eval, and every mismatch is explained in {T}/stage0/mismatches.md.

per_task.title: Prove repeat runs and the sham edit are identical
per_task.detail: 100 seeds twice into repeat_a.jsonl and repeat_b.jsonl, and once with every head scaled by 1 into sham.jsonl. All three must match exactly, traj_hash included.

per_task.title: Choose one renderer
per_task.detail: Compare GPU and software rendering on the reproduction seeds where both exist. Write the choice to {T}/stage0/renderer.json and never switch after this.

per_task.title: Run the design seeds at four settings
per_task.detail: Seeds 20000 to 20999 at 100-step chunks (design_default.jsonl), 50 (design_chunk50.jsonl) and 25 (design_chunk25.jsonl). Temporal ensembling at 0.01 on at least 200 of them (design_ens.jsonl). All under {T}/stage1/.

per_task.title: Draw the failure map and the reach-error plot
per_task.detail: {T}/stage1/failure_map.png and reach_error.png, plus frame strips of 30 failures and 10 successes in {T}/stage1/strips/. Include the 41 by 41 grid and the training-demo overlay from SPEC.md Stage 1.

per_task.title: Apply the Gate 1 rules
per_task.detail: Write {T}/stage1/decisions.json with primary_metric, operating_point.n_action_steps, proceed, target_failure_class and tracking_number. The referee recomputes the first three from the design runs, so apply the rules in referee/RULES.md exactly.

per_task.title: Write the diagnosis
per_task.detail: {T}/diagnosis.md with sections named Target failure, Tracking number, Near-miss evidence, Primary metric and Operating point. A fresh reviewer will try to refute it.

per_task.title: Build the open-loop head atlas
per_task.detail: No rollouts. Per SPEC.md Stage 2, for all 48 heads. Write {T}/stage2/atlas/heads.json and the figures beside it.

per_task.title: Run the closed-loop sweep
per_task.detail: All 96 single-head edits (each head at x0 and x2) on seeds 20000 to 20499, paired with the original, into {T}/stage2/sweep.jsonl. Start it with run/jobs.py and end the session while it runs.

per_task.title: Run the split-half check
per_task.detail: Re-run the best 10 by success gain and the best 5 by overlap on seeds 20500 to 20999. Write {T}/stage2/split_half.json with rechecked and kept.

per_task.title: Write a hypothesis before each candidate
per_task.detail: One line in {T}/hypotheses.md per candidate, naming its id, before it is evaluated. Every candidate checked on validation seeds must appear there.

per_task.title: Check dose response
per_task.detail: Candidate heads at x0.5, x1.5, x2, x3 and x4 on design seeds. Write {T}/stage3/dose_response.json. The tracking number should move in step.

per_task.title: Tune and freeze the simple baselines
per_task.detail: Constant offset, deviation gain, shorter chunk and your own simplest fix, tuned on the same design seeds with real effort. Write {T}/freeze/baselines.json. Each family gets one validation check.

per_task.title: Check candidates on the validation seeds
per_task.detail: At most 10 candidates, ever, on seeds 30000 to 30499. The original goes in {T}/stage3/validation/original.jsonl and each candidate in <candidate>.jsonl. Never adjust a candidate after seeing its validation result.

per_task.title: Choose the edit
per_task.detail: Write {T}/freeze/edit.json for one candidate, with its ops, hypothesis and the SHA-256 of the exported checkpoint. If nothing passed validation, the stop rule says freeze the best one anyway and say so.

per_task.title: Assemble the freeze package
per_task.detail: {T}/freeze/ holds autogreedy.json (built by a script, name it in built_by), random_family.json, test_manifest.json listing every arm in SPEC.md Stage 5, and analysis.py already run on validation data.

per_task.title: Keep the ledger inside the rules
per_task.detail: Every rollout is in ledger/. Only reproduction, design and validation seeds, or explicit poses. Budgets and the validation cap hold. python -m referee.recompute ledger shows the counts.

per_task.title: Keep the record clean
per_task.detail: No protected file changed. PROGRESS.md and DEVIATIONS.md only ever grew. No gradient or optimiser code anywhere. decisions.json unchanged since Gate 1.

per_task.title: Request the freeze
per_task.detail: When everything above passes and the tree is committed, write {T}/freeze/REQUEST.json and commit it. A reviewer reads the package, then the referee checks it, tags it and runs the test. You do not run the test.

per_task.title: Write the report from the referee's results
per_task.detail: {T}/report/report.md with the referee's verdict block from {T}/test/VERDICT.md copied in unchanged, the before and after maps, the fixed and broken table by failure class, the random-edit histogram, the dose-response curve and the baselines side by side. At least 3 figures. The verdict is final, whatever it says.

per_task.title: Run the stress checks
per_task.detail: Main task only. The frozen edit and the original on cube positions in a 3 cm band outside the square, and on cubes rotated by 15 and 30 degrees. Write {T}/stage6/stress.json with band_3cm, rotation_15 and rotation_30. Reported, not judged.

global.title: Draft the post
global.detail: publish/post.md, built around the referee's headline tables for every task, the maps, and the limits from SPEC.md. State every ending plainly, including a null.

global.title: Write the publishing checklist for Andrew
global.detail: publish/CHECKLIST.md. What a person must do by hand, such as uploading the edited checkpoint to the hub, attaching the session logs, and running python -m referee.verify_draw on each test folder.
